name: Peninsula Gardens | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Sour Traverse City Cherry
description: The best high in an edible comes from live rosin. Our gummies contain all of the cannabinoids that naturally occur in the plant giving you a nice natural high unlike distillate that strips the plant of some of its greatest attributes. 10 20mg pieces per pack for a total of 200mg gives the ability to dose at your own leisure. The live rosin still has a slight cannabis taste but paired with our delicious flavors it's not too overpowering.
